title: Use Map Robot Selection “Go to” to reposition an AGV to a selected square
summary: Use the RMS / fleet status UI map’s Robot Selection “Go to” workflow to send an AGV that is not currently in a task to a selected destination square. The source presents this as a quick recovery method for a stalled/blocked situation (example: a tipper goes down and an AGV will not leave; after the tote is removed, the AGV can pick up a new task).
when_to_use: When an AGV is not in a task and you need to recover quickly by sending it to a chosen map square using Robot Selection “Go to” (example use case described: a tipper goes down and an AGV will not leave; after the tote is removed, the AGV can resume by picking up a new task).
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Execute the RMS map Robot Selection “Go to” workflow (select AGV object → Go to → select destination square → Confirm) and verify the AGV resumes tasking after the described recovery condition.
operator: Provide on-floor confirmation of the blocking condition being cleared (e.g., tote removed) and observe whether the AGV resumes work after the command.
access_or_tools_needed: RMS / fleet status UI (map with selectable objects and Robot Selection “Go to” controls)

access_required: Access to RMS / fleet status UI
system_preconditions: The map view must support selecting operational objects (not only clicking on the map background).

visual_references.description: Robot Selection “Go-to” function overview and the step sequence: Select an AGV → Select Go to → Select which square → Select Confirm; includes the recovery example (tipper down; AGV not leaving; tote removed; AGV picks up a new task).

steps.title: Open the RMS map view that supports selecting operational objects
steps.purpose: Ensure the map is in an object-select mode so selecting an AGV triggers the Robot Selection workflow (not a generic map click).
steps.instruction: In the RMS / fleet status UI, open the map view that allows selecting operational objects (AGVs/cells). Avoid clicking only on the map background.
steps.expected_result: You can select operational objects on the map (AGV/cell selection is recognized by the UI).
steps.healthy_condition: Selecting an AGV object is possible; generic map clicking does not perform the Robot Selection action.
steps.failure_condition: If you click on the map background (not an operational object), no Robot Selection action occurs.

actions.label: Verify object-select behavior
actions.exact_action: Select operational objects on the map (not just click on the map background).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “These are the objects that you can select on the map… If you just click on the map, nothing will happen because the map doesn't know if you're trying to select an AGB or a cell…”

The training segment explains that operators select specific objects on the map, and that clicking the map by itself does not trigger an action because the interface requires object-specific selection.

steps.title: Select the specific AGV object on the map
steps.purpose: Target the correct AGV for the Robot Selection “Go to” command.
steps.instruction: On the RMS map, select the specific AGV object (do not select a generic map area).
steps.expected_result: The selected AGV is identified by the UI as the target for Robot Selection.
steps.healthy_condition: The AGV object selection is active (the UI is ready to show Robot Selection options for that AGV).
steps.failure_condition: No AGV is selected (or selection is not recognized), so Robot Selection options cannot be applied to the intended AGV.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Robot Selection Go-to function reference from training slide: an AGV that is not currently in a task can be sent to any square.

steps.title: Select the Robot Selection “Go to” function for the selected AGV
steps.purpose: Choose the command that repositions an AGV that is not currently in a task.
steps.instruction: After selecting the AGV on the RMS map, choose the Robot Selection “Go to” function for that AGV.
steps.expected_result: The UI enters the “Go to” flow for the selected AGV (ready to choose a destination square).
steps.healthy_condition: “Go to” is selected for the AGV and the next action is selecting a destination square.
steps.failure_condition: “Go to” is not available/does not activate for the selected AGV, or the UI does not proceed to destination square selection.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “Robot Selection Go-to function… An AGV not in a task can be sent to any square.”

steps.title: Select the destination square on the map
steps.purpose: Define where the AGV should be repositioned.
steps.instruction: In the “Go to” flow, select the destination square on the RMS map where you want the AGV to go.
steps.expected_result: A destination square is selected as the target for the AGV “Go to” command.
steps.healthy_condition: The chosen square is accepted by the UI and the flow proceeds to confirmation.
steps.failure_condition: No destination square can be selected/accepted, or the UI does not proceed to the Confirm step.

actions.label: Select destination square
actions.exact_action: Select which square you want the AGV to go to.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “3. Select which square you want the AGV to go to”

steps.title: Select “Confirm” to send the AGV to the selected square
steps.purpose: Transmit the reposition command to the system.
steps.instruction: Select “Confirm” to send the selected AGV to the selected destination square.
steps.expected_result: The “Go to” command is confirmed and issued for the selected AGV to the selected square.
steps.healthy_condition: After confirmation, the AGV is no longer treated as “not in a task” and can resume work after the described recovery condition is cleared.
steps.failure_condition: The map action does not take effect (e.g., the AGV does not move / does not resume tasking after the recovery condition described).
stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the map action does not take effect (e.g., selecting the map background causes no action, or the AGV does not move / does not resume tasking after the recovery condition described).
If the AGV remains unable to leave the area despite using “Go to,” escalate for deeper troubleshooting of the underlying blockage.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “This is helpful when trying to recover quickly. Example if a Tipper goes down and an AGV will not leave. You can remove and add the agv and use the go to function to drop it off at the hospital.”

steps.title: Verify AGV resumes tasking after the described recovery condition (e.g., tote removed)
steps.purpose: Confirm the recovery outcome: the AGV can pick up a new task once the blocking tote is removed.
steps.instruction: After issuing “Go to” and clearing the described blockage condition (example: tote removed), observe that the AGV resumes by picking up a new task.
steps.expected_result: The AGV picks up a new task after its tote has been removed (as described in the recovery example).
steps.healthy_condition: AGV tasking resumes after the tote removal; the AGV is no longer stuck in the described “not leaving” situation.
steps.failure_condition: AGV remains unable to leave the area and does not resume tasking after the recovery condition described.

actions.label: Observe task resumption
actions.exact_action: Observe that the AGV will pickup a new task once it's tote has been removed.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the AGV remains unable to leave the area despite using “Go to,” escalate for deeper troubleshooting of the underlying blockage (example ties recovery to tipper-down and tote removal).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “The AGV will pickup a new task once it's tote has been removed.”
The slide states that in the described scenario, the AGV will pick up a new task once its tote has been removed.

success_criteria: The AGV is sent to the chosen map square via Robot Selection “Go to” + “Confirm”.
In the described recovery scenario, after the tote is removed, the AGV picks up a new task.
healthy_conditions: Selecting operational objects on the map triggers the Robot Selection workflow (generic map clicks do not do anything).
After “Go to” + “Confirm,” the AGV resumes tasking after the described blockage condition is cleared (tote removed in the example).
failure_conditions: Map action does not take effect (e.g., clicking the map background causes no action).
AGV does not move / does not resume tasking after the recovery condition described.
AGV remains unable to leave the area despite using “Go to.”
escalation_guidance: Stop and escalate if the map action does not take effect or if the AGV does not resume tasking after the described recovery condition.
If the AGV remains unable to leave the area despite using “Go to,” escalate for deeper troubleshooting of the underlying blockage.
